split_provenance: both carved from CUAD's official TRAIN split; these contracts are inside the released checkpoints' fine-tuning data

intersection: OTISWORLDWIDECORP_04_03_2020-EX-10.4-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT by and among UNITED TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION, OTIS WORLDWIDE CORPORATION and CARRIER ~1

test_meta.gold: CUAD official test split (102 contracts x 41 categories)

paper_presentation.caption: Comparison of AUPR for DeBERTa-xlarge across different label categories. While performance is high for some labels, it is has much room for improvement for other labels.
paper_presentation.what_is_plotted: per-category AUPR, single model (DeBERTa-xlarge), horizontal bars, x-axis 0-100, categories sorted descending by AUPR
paper_presentation.extraction: y-axis tick labels read in order from the figure region of the published PDF (page 7, right column) by word position; bar values are not machine-readable from the PDF and were NOT extracted
paper_presentation.note: The caption and body text say all 41 categories; only 40 labels appear on the axis. The missing one is Price Restrictions, which scores AUPR 0.000 for all three released checkpoints in our reproduction.

method.unit: contract (paired; same resampled contract set used in both arms)
method.seed_handling: per-contract TP/FP/FN averaged over that contract's scored seeds before aggregation; resampling unit stays the contract
method.estimator: micro-pooled over resampled contracts: precision = sum(TP)/(sum(TP)+sum(FP)), recall = sum(TP)/(sum(TP)+sum(FN)), micro-F1 = harmonic mean
method.scorer: data/raw/evaluate.py via scripts/score_c2c3_with_cuad_evaluator.py (unmodified upstream get_jaccard, IOU_THRESH=0.5)
